Mode: built-in image_gen. Exactly two calls; no iterations.

## background.png

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: WithYou relaxing indie game website background, wide 16:9 approximately 1920x1080.
Primary request: An original warm cozy stylized 3D diorama of a sheltered coastal meadow, a calm lived-in place shared by tiny young adult companions.
Scene/backdrop: Gentle grassy seaside clearing, tranquil clearly visible blue sea and soft powder blue sky. Leafy trees flank both edges and extend overhead. Foreground wildflower tufts, rounded rocks, soft rounded chunky foliage and grass clumps.
Subject: Exactly five tiny young adult companions wearing modern oversize tees and casual clothing, naturally spaced primarily in the left and center of the clearing. Some sit reading or using a laptop, one reclines comfortably in the grass.
Style/medium: Tactile simplified whimsical 3D indie game environment with rounded forms, soft ambient occlusion and gentle atmosphere. The scenery feels like a playable cozy game.
Composition/framing: Wide landscape image. Most scenery, open sea and character story on the left 60%. Right 40% has a darker softly simplified plum and sage tree canopy, quiet and uncluttered enough to serve as backdrop for white website text, but do not draw that text. Also usable as a full background behind a centered introductory cloud.
Lighting/mood: Warm late afternoon sunlight enters from upper left; lavender shadows, tranquil and welcoming.
Constraints: Entirely original scene and characters. No houses, castles, fences, furniture, UI, text, logos or watermarks. Not photorealistic, not crisp detailed anime brush illustration. Do not copy Tiny Glade scenes or characters.

## wordmark.png

Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: transparent PNG hand-lettered wordmark for WithYou, a warm relaxing indie game.
Primary request: Pure text logo in warm white/ivory, exact brand spelling "WithYou", elegantly stacked with "With" above "You".
Text (verbatim): First line "With". Second line "You". Together read WithYou. W-i-t-h-Y-o-u. No other text.
Style/medium: Large friendly relaxed brush lettering, organic variable strokes, subtle drybrush ends and a gently uneven baseline. Legible, whimsical indie game identity, soft and welcoming.
Composition/framing: The two lines form one compact cohesive mark and fill 85–90% of the canvas with no big padding.
Background: Genuinely transparent background with actual PNG alpha channel. Preserve ivory letter strokes and delicate brush edges against transparency.
Constraints: Pure text only. No emblem, leaves, flowers, waves, icons, box, background color, background texture, shadow or additional text. Avoid corporate script, wedding calligraphy, overly thin strokes, and copying Tiny Glade's distinctive letters.
scope: Original generated art; no reference site assets copied. Approved for the WithYou website and GitHub publication.
